# Grade H = read from the period table; M = number or value uncertain at the reading scale. The 22-letter row uses all of 1-22 exactly once per code-slot, which supports the reading but each figure was read at ~0.48x.

# Persons named (Card. Tournon d.1562, Mar. S. Andrea d.1562, Mar. Termes d.1562, Card. Borromeo cr.1560, "il S.r Fed.co Gonzaga mio fr.llo") place the table about 1560-62 and the writer as a Gonzaga (Nevers' brother Federico). Not a dating claim beyond that.
